text: The KX-41 inspection drone was developed by the Talvane Robotics Lab, which designed it to survey offshore wind turbine blades without stopping the rotors.

metadata.title: Talvane lab unveils KX-41 inspection drone

text: Engineers at the lab said the KX-41 can hover in gusts of up to 60 km/h and streams thermal images to a ground crew in real time.

metadata.title: Talvane lab unveils KX-41 inspection drone

text: Dr. Imara Solberg has directed the Talvane Robotics Lab since 2021, after a decade building underwater vehicles for marine surveys.
Under her leadership the lab tripled its staff and opened a second test site on the Merrow coast.
An earlier prototype, the KX-40, was grounded last summer after a battery fault during a demonstration flight; no one was injured.

metadata.title: KX-40 prototype grounded after battery fault

text: The Elsmoor Growers Collective took home the 2025 Greenfield Award for low-water agriculture, beating eleven other nominees.
Judges praised the collective's drip-irrigation network, which cut its water use by almost half in three seasons.
Members of the Elsmoor Growers Collective cultivate mostly apricots on terraced hillsides above the river.
A smaller share of the terraces is given over to almonds and to a heritage plum variety that the members are trying to revive.
The 2024 Greenfield Award went to a dairy partnership in the northern hills, recognised for converting manure into biogas.
Calder Freight, founded in 1987, announced a cargo partnership with Brightwing Air in 2024 to move refrigerated goods between island ports.
The shipping firm said the deal would add four weekly cargo flights during the harvest season.
Brightwing Air began flying in 1972 from a single grass airfield, carrying mail and passengers to three islands.
Today the airline operates a mixed fleet of turboprops and is still owned by the founding family.
Calder Freight opened a refrigerated depot at the eastern quay, its first new building in more than a decade.
On 12 February 2026, Linden Bay mayor Tomas Ferro announced a tram expansion that would link the old town with the university campus.

metadata.title: Linden Bay mayor unveils tram plan

text: The plan adds six stops and is expected to take four years to build.

metadata.title: Linden Bay mayor unveils tram plan

text: The Linden Bay city council approved the harbour budget on 3 March 2026, after two weeks of debate over dredging costs.
Councillors also asked for a separate review of ferry fares.
Construction of the Linden Bay aquarium entered its final phase this winter, and the operators expect to open the doors in late spring.
The building will house a kelp tank fed by seawater pumped directly from the bay.
The harbour's ferry operator ordered two electric boats, which will replace diesel vessels on the shortest crossing.
Regulators approved the expansion of the Merrow offshore wind farm, adding twelve turbines by 2028.
Maintenance crews say regular blade inspections will become one of the largest costs of running the site.
Students showed climbing robots, sorting arms and a swimming drone during the university's annual robotics week.
Wholesale apricot prices fell by a fifth after a bumper season across the valley, according to the regional market board.

metadata.title: Apricot prices fall after bumper season

text: Visitor numbers to the islands rose again this year, helped by new direct flights and a longer summer ferry timetable.
